comparison.objective: Free a selected panel from a leaning rack while safely relocating dependent panels, versus damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Reasoning about supported loads, large-panel stabilization, and upright placement, not fine rotary adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Red panel on inspection plate and moved panels upright on mat; stability angles and forbidden-motion tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests dependency-aware extraction and load stabilization, not mechanical calibration.
